sources.snippet: SAM 3D Body: Robust Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery Meta Superintelligence Labs SAM 3D Body (3DB) is a promptable model for single-image full-body 3D human mesh recovery (HMR). Our method demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, with strong generalization and consistent accuracy in diverse in-the-wild conditions. 3DB estimates the human pose of the body, feet, and hands based on the Momentum ...

sources.snippet: F32 GGUF conversions of Meta's facebook/sam-3d-body-dinov3 for sam3d.cpp, a C++23/GGML CPU/Vulkan implementation. Given an image and a selected person's bounding box, the supported Body pose branch estimates a 3D body mesh, joints, pose parameters and camera translation.
